sections.content: Use the simple future to make predictions about society and to describe what will happen later.

items.spanish: La tecnología tendrá un papel importante.
items.english: Technology will have an important role.

items.spanish: Muchas profesiones desaparecerán y otras nuevas aparecerán.
items.english: Many professions will disappear and other new ones will appear.

sections.content: For predictions with no fixed timeframe — what society *will* look like someday — the simple future fits better than *ir* *a* + infinitive, which suggests a nearer, already-planned future.
